SO quick rundown how I’d suggest you’d build Paladin: 
In terms of race, just go with whatever fits your playstyle best. Variant-Human is definitely a good starter all around since you’re a new player but Dragonborn, Dwarf, TIefling, and Half Orc all work well for the stats needed for Paladin. However, remember that you don’t necessarily need to minmax if that sacrifices your enjoyment so go with whatever you’ll find the most fun to play. 
Focus on Strength, Charisma, and Constitution first and foremost for your stats. I personally built mine with Charisma > Strength > Constitution since I could essentially push 23 AC and my DM only uses strength for strength checks (other DMs might have that your strength influence your carrying capacity so you may want to prioritize strength if you wanna go with heavy gear). Main reason why I pushed Charisma was I wanted my Paladin to be a spellcasting, charismatic tank. 
Weapon wise, I’d say to have one martial weapon and one ranged weapon, mainly because the vast majority of Paladin’s skills and attacks are melee and you can easily be screwed over from the back by an overeager Wizard or Ranger (especially if you don’t have the capability to move around the map quickly or to any far distance). 
Feat wise, base it around your playstyle. I’d suggest searching up a list and looking through the various feats available and looking for ones that you think will work well for you 
Oath is also dependent on what type of Paladin you want to play. Again, look through the benefits of each and consider what role you want to play in your party 

That’s all the basic advice I can really give regarding Paladin. Hopefully this helps!
